name: Spearmint
description: Spearmint is a vigorous aromatic perennial herb known for its characteristic spear-shaped leaves and refreshing aroma.
use: Fresh tea, and it spreads everywhere. Popular in cold drinks, herbal infusions, and Mediterranean salads.
tips: Plant in containers or bordered beds to prevent rhizomes from invading other plants. Thrives in moist soil and partial to full sunlight.
